label: All corridors open
description: The planned network with every road and river leg open.

label: Jonglei flooding
description: Rainy-season flooding closes the Juba–Bor road and the Bor–Pibor, Pibor–Akobo and Bor–Ayod tracks.

label: Sobat corridor insecurity
description: Insecurity closes the Sobat river leg and the Ulang–Nasir track.

label: Unity access cut
description: The Rumbek–Leer track and the Leer–Bentiu road are closed.

label: Compound disruption
description: Jonglei flooding, Sobat insecurity and an accident on the Juba–Nimule highway at the same time.
